scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Unio--
I-Impossible! How c-can
something like this happen?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士联--
不...不可能！怎...怎么可能发生这种事？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome, {0}.
The Alchemist Union
is busy today, like always.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎光临，{0}。
炼金术士联盟今天也很忙碌，一如既往。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
We are recruiting
talented people
with novel ideas.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士联盟。
我们正在招募拥有新颖想法的
有才华的人。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Welcome to the
Alchemist Union.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
欢迎来到炼金术士联盟。
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well now~!
You've brought an
Old Magic Book and
a Hammer of Blacksmith.
We'll put these items
to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀~！
您带来了一本古魔法书
和一把高级铁砧。
我们会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Seems like
you're all ready.
The Union will put
these items to good use.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
看来您已经准备好了。
联盟会好好利用这些物品的。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Aren't you ready?
Like I said before,
you must bring
^551A8B{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
您还没准备好吗？
就像我之前说的，
您必须带来^551A8B{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Go and talk to
Mr. Raspuchin.
He's involved in the
Alchemist selection process, whatever that might mean.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
去和拉斯普京先生谈谈吧。
他负责炼金术士的选拔工作，
虽然具体是什么意思我也不太清楚。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Ah, I'm sorry, but
I'm busy right now~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
啊，抱歉，
我现在正忙着呢~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Wait, wait...
I'm sorry. I was confused,
that's all. You look just like
someone I used to know. 
Still, I get this weird
feeling about you...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
等等，等等...
抱歉。我刚才有点恍惚。
您看起来很像我以前认识的一个人。
不过，我对您有一种奇怪的感觉...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is busy with their
own research, but recently, some headway has been made in the field of biotechnology.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都在忙于自己的研究，
但最近，在生命工学研究领域
取得了一些进展。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Everyone is hoping that the biotechnological studies will yield positive results. Speaking of which, I wonder how the Alchemists working on artificial life are doing...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大家都希望生命工学研究能取得积极成果。
说到这个，不知道那些从事人造生命研究的炼金术士们怎么样了...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you're interested in working with chemistry, visit us later when you become more knowledgable.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果您对化学研究感兴趣，
等您知识更丰富一些时，
欢迎再来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Just one thing:
You've got to have
knowledge of items
as a Merchant first.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
只有一点：
您必须先作为商人
掌握物品知识。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you know any exceptional Merchants, by all means, please refer them to us. Those types of people tend to have a talent for Alchemy and experimentation~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果您认识任何出色的商人，
请务必推荐给我们。
这类人通常对融合试验和实验很有天赋~

scripts.text: I would like to learn about Alchemists.
scripts.translation: 我想了解炼金术士。

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alchemists study and create new substances and items out of existing materials. Our knowledge allows us to change the properties of chemicals at the atomic level.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
炼金术士研究并利用现有材料创造新的物质和物品。我们的知识使我们能够在原子层面改变化学物质的性质。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Most people think our final goal
is to create gold, but that's not the entire truth. We also want to create things like medicines
and new materials.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
大多数人认为我们的最终目标是点石成金，但这并非全部真相。我们还希望创造药物和新材料。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
A few of us research the
creation of life, although many of us consider that god's territory. That field is so complex, most of us deal with slightly less complicated projects anyway.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
我们中有少数人研究生命的创造，尽管许多人认为那是神的领域。那个领域太复杂了，大多数人还是处理稍微简单一点的项目。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you are interested in becoming an Alchemist, I recommend that you first get a lot of experience as a Merchant. Being a Merchant is a great opportunity to learn about materials as you deal with them.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你对成为炼金术士感兴趣，我建议你先积累商人的经验。作为商人，在处理材料的过程中，是学习材料知识的好机会。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Whether or not you try to become
an Alchemist is your decision. The road to becoming an Alchemist is very challenging, and you'll need to focus on experimentation and research, instead of commerce.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
是否尝试成为炼金术士由你自己决定。成为炼金术士的道路充满挑战，你需要专注于实验和研究，而不是商业。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Is that so?
Nice to meet you.
My name is Parmy Gianino
of the Alchemist Union.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
是吗？
很高兴见到你。
我是炼金术士公会的帕米·吉亚尼诺。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
If you join our Union and
complete the training, you
will be officially recognized
as an Alchemist and be able
to contribute to our research.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你加入我们的公会并完成培训，你将正式被承认为炼金术士，并能为我们的研究做出贡献。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But we don't accept everyone.
You must have a lot of tenacity
and sincere devotion in exploring
the various fields of science.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但我们不会接受所有人。
你必须具备坚韧的毅力，以及对探索科学各个领域的真诚热情。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
There are a couple
of requirements to join
the Alchemist Union, but
we'll discuss that
after you apply.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
加入炼金术士公会有一些要求，
但我们会在你申请后再讨论这些细节。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Well then, would
you like to apply
for registration?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
那么，
你想申请注册吗？

scripts.text: I would like to apply.
scripts.translation: 我想申请。

scripts.text: I'll do it later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hmmm...
Just a moment.
I'm sorry to say that
you're not experienced
enough as a Merchant to
join us right now.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯...
请稍等。
很遗憾，你作为商人的经验还不够，
目前无法加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
You must be at least
^551A8BJob Level 40^000000 to become
an Alchemist. Come back
later when you meet the
Job Level requirement, okay?
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
你必须达到^551A8B职业等级40^000000才能成为炼金术士。
等你满足职业等级要求后再来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Alright, your application has been accepted. Now, you must pay the 50,000 Zeny application fee and bring some items before you can begin your formal training.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好的，你的申请已被接受。现在，你需要支付50,000 Zeny的申请费，并携带一些物品，才能开始正式培训。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But if you bring an ^551A8BOld Magic Book^000000 and ^551A8BHammer of Blacksmith^000000,
we will accept that as a substitute for the item requirement.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但如果你携带^551A8B古魔法书^000000和^551A8B高级铁砧^000000，
我们可以接受这些物品作为替代要求。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Now...
Please sign
the application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
现在...
请在申请表上签字。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Good, good. Now, if you have
the Zeny for your application fee ready, I will tell you which items you will need to bring. Now, pay attention.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
很好。现在，如果你已经准备好申请费的Zeny，我会告诉你需要携带哪些物品。请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Uh oh. You don't
seem to have enough Zeny.
Come back to me when you have 50,000 Zeny, otherwise we can't process your application.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
哎呀。你似乎没有足够的Zeny。
等你有50,000 Zeny时再来找我，否则我们无法处理你的申请。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要携带...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7 Berserk Potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要携带...
^551A8B7瓶菠色克药水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B100 Mini Furnaces^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要携带...
^551A8B100个携带用熔矿炉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Let's see.
{0}
needs to bring...
^551A8B7,500 Fire Arrows^000000.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
让我看看。
{0}
需要携带...
^551A8B7,500支火箭矢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Once you've gathered
those items, come back
to me and your training
as an Alchemist will begin.
See you soon~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
收集好那些物品后，
回来找我，
你的炼金术士训练
就会开始了。
回头见~

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Talented Merchants
are always welcome here.
Please come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
有才华的商人
在这里总是受欢迎的。
请快点回来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Umm...
Please let me know
if you need anything.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
嗯...
如果你需要什么，
请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好了，现在你需要学习
成为炼金术士的基础知识，
以及混合化学药品和药剂的流程。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但在这一切之前，
你需要去和拉斯普钦·格雷戈里对话。
我也不太确定你们会聊些什么...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事情，
但你仍然必须去和拉斯普钦·格雷戈里对话，
因为显然他是炼金术士选拔过程的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Okay, now you need to learn
the basics to being an Alchemist and learn the procedures for mixing chemicals and medicines.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
好了，现在你需要学习
成为炼金术士的基础知识，
以及混合化学药品和药剂的流程。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
But before all of that, you need to speak to Raspuchin. I'm not really sure what you'll be talking about with him...
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
但在这一切之前，
你需要去和拉斯普钦·格雷戈里对话。
我也不太确定你们会聊些什么...

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
It shouldn't be anything extraordinary, but you're still required to speak to Raspuchin, since apparently he's a part of the Alchemist selection process.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
应该不是什么特别的事情，
但你仍然必须去和拉斯普钦·格雷戈里对话，
因为显然他是炼金术士选拔过程的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Come back when you
have prepared the
required items.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
准备好所需物品后
再回来。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Hopefully, it
won't be too much of
a problem. I guess he'll just interview you, and ask you
some simple questions.
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
希望不会
造成太大的麻烦。
我想他只会面试你，
问一些简单的问题。

scripts.text:
[Parmy Gianino]
Why don't you ask
someone else if you're
not sure who to visit
next? Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[帕米·吉亚尼诺]
如果你不确定
接下来该找谁，
为什么不问问别人呢？
祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
Eh? What do you want?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~!
呃？你想干什么？!

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
How cute, you've come
all this way just to play...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~!
真可爱，你大老远
跑来只是为了玩...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What is it?!
You're curious as
to what I'm doing?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
怎么了？!
你对我正在做的事
感到好奇？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
What do you
want, kid?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻嘻
呵呵呵~!
你想干什么，
小孩？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?!
You want to take
the test again?!
I thought I told
you to leave!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么？!
你想重新参加测试？!
我告诉过你
让我走开！

scripts.text: [Raspuchin Gregory]
scripts.translation: [拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What are you doing?
Go and find Darwin now.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你在做什么？
现在去找达尔文。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵~
别以为这就结束了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not here to steal my experimental results or plagiarize my work, are you? How dare you consider intellectual theft!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你不会是想偷我的实验结果
或剽窃我的作品吧？
你怎么敢考虑窃取知识产权！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not, are you?
Well, as a colleague,
let me just warn you
that such tricks aren't
tolerated here in the
Alchemist Union!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你不会吧？
好吧，作为同事，
我要警告你，
这种把戏在炼金术士联盟
是不被容忍的！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
I'll let you
go this time...
But next time, don't
expect to leave so easily...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
这次我放过你...
但下次，别指望
能这么轻易离开...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heehee
keheheh~!
Why, I'm busy
researching,
of course!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘿嘿
呵呵呵~！
我当然是在
做研究啦！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Once this
potion is complete...
You can use it to take
over an entire nation!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等这瓶药水
研制完成...
你就能用它
征服整个国家！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Hee hee hee!
Something this
dangerous has to
be kept a secret!
Understand?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘿嘿嘿！
这么危险的东西
必须保密！
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
A Merchant should go and set up shop and vend items. Why are you wandering in a place like this?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
商人应该去摆摊卖东西才对。你为什么会在这种地方闲逛？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heheheh~!
Go vend somwhere else!
And leave me to my
dark enterprise!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵~！
去别的地方摆摊吧！
别打扰我
进行我的邪恶计划！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Learn Alchemy?!
Don't even speak
such nonsense!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么...？
学习炼金术术？！
别胡说八道了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Even if you tried studying for a thousand years, maybe even more, it'd be useless to you! Forget about it and just worry about your store!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
就算你学上千年，甚至更久，对你来说也是徒劳！别想了，好好管你的店吧！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
What...?
Join the Union!?
I don't like it...
I just don't...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
什么...？
加入联盟？！
我不喜欢...
我就是不...！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Nowadays, anyone thinks they can
be Alchemists just by knowing how to mix a few herbs. That's why my interview is necessary.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
现在，只要知道怎么混合几株草药，就觉得自己能当炼金术士了。这就是为什么我的面试是必要的。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Heeheehee
keheheh~!
I plan on weeding out all the dumb and incompetent, and chase them
all away! We don't need morons!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘿嘿嘿
呵呵呵~！
我打算把所有愚蠢无能的人
都淘汰掉！我们不需要笨蛋！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
You might be a pretty boy,
but I can tell you're smart
from your eyes.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等等...
也许是我
看错你了。
你虽然是个帅哥，
但我看得出你很聪明。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Wait...
Maybe I've
misjudged you.
Huh. You're a cutie alright,
but I can tell you've got brains.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
等等...
也许是我
看错你了。
嗯。你确实是个美人，
但我看得出你很聪明。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You're not just some stupid kid.
I can tell youve gone through some rough times as a Merchant. Excellent. Keh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你并不是个愚蠢的小孩。
看得出你作为商人经历过不少磨难。很好。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Fine, just so we don't insult each other's intelligence, I'll just let you pass the interview.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
好吧，为了不让彼此显得愚蠢，我就让你通过面试吧。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
So hurry up, become an Alchemist, do some good research, and you might turn out to be of some help to me. Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
所以快点，成为炼金术士，做些好的研究，也许你会对我有点帮助。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Now go to Darwin!
He'll teach you how to do the experiments. Just tell him that
I sent you.
scripts.translation:

现在去找达尔文！
他会教你怎么做实验。只要告诉他
是我派你来的。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Surprised, are you?
Keheheh~ If you thought
becoming an Alchemist was
just a matter of changing
your clothes, then you're
sadly mistaken.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
很惊讶吗？
呵呵呵~ 如果你以为
成为炼金术士
只是换身衣服的事，
那你可就大错特错了。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Now, try solving
all these problems.
Let's see how smart
really are.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
现在，试着
解决这些问题。
让我看看你
到底有多聪明。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
I don't like it...
I don't like this!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
我不喜欢...
我不喜欢这样！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Fine...
I'll try to overlook your pitiful performance last time and give
you another chance. Don't screw
up again, got it?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
好吧...
我会试着原谅你上次那糟糕的表现，再给你一次机会。别再搞砸了，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Ooh...
Excellent! Great!
You got them all correct!?
Keheheh, I have no choice but to acknowledge you...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
噢...
太棒了！真厉害！
你全都答对了！？
嘿嘿嘿，我不得不承认你...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You got one wrong!
But I'll let it slide.
You pass the interview!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你答错了一道题！
不过我可以原谅你。
你通过了面试！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
You've got serious
weaknesses in math,
but I'll let you go this time...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
你的数学能力
真的很糟糕，
但这次我就放过你...

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! Idiot!
Just listening to your
answers is making me feel
stupider! You might as well
have got them all wrong!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘿嘿嘿！笨蛋！
光是听你的回答
就让我觉得自己更蠢了！
你最好全都答错算了！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
How can a person that
can't even answer all of
these simple questions think
of becoming an Alchemist?!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
连这些简单的问题
都答不全的人，
居然还想成为炼金术士？！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Hm...?
Did you get
any right?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嗯...？
你答对
任何一道题了吗？

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Fool! Even if you make one little mistake, everything goes wrong
in Alchemy! Now get out of here!
You make me sick!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
蠢货！哪怕只犯一个小错误，
融合试验就会彻底失败！
现在给我滚出去！
你让我恶心！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
So hurry up, become an Alchemist, do some good research, and you might turn out to be of some help to me. Hahahahahaha~!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
所以快点，成为炼金术士，做些好的研究，也许你会对我有点帮助。哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Now go to Darwin!
He'll teach you how to do the experiments. Just tell him that
I sent you.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
现在去找达尔文！
他会教你怎么做实验。只要告诉他
是我派你来的。

scripts.text:
[Raspuchin Gregory]
Keheheheheheheheh~
Don't think this is the end of it!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵~
别以为这就结束了！

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你身上携带的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 请先将部分物品存入 -
- 卡普拉仓库后再回来。 -

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
You...
You've become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
你...
你已经成为
一名炼金术士了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
When you have
your dreams, you
have everything.
Without them, you have
nothing more to lose.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
当你拥有梦想时，
你就拥有一切。
失去梦想，你便
再无所有。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...

[Darwin]
I said to go
to Van Helmont.
I'd like to teach you
more, but I can't.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我让你去找
范·赫尔蒙特。
我想教你更多，
但我无能为力。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I have already given you all of my knowledge and have nothing more
to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我已经将我所知的一切都传授给你了，
再没有更多能教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Remember...
In your quest
to make your
dreams come true,
do not lose what
you cherish.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
记住...
在追求梦想成真的路上，
不要失去
你所珍视的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ah...
Harmona...
My love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
哈莫娜...
我的爱人...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这该死的双眼...
早已看不见
我的梦想了。
哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂
真的存在吗...？
没有我的爱人...
没有哈莫娜...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
A wolf?
Or a human?
You must be seeking
something, are you not?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是狼？
还是人类？
你一定是在寻找
什么东西，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
After all...
Everyone has desires
to fulfill. Be be careful.
Do not be like the wild
wolf drawn to the flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
毕竟...
每个人都有
想要实现的欲望。小心啊。
不要像被花朵吸引的
野狼那样。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
In your efforts to gain something else, you may end up sacrificing something precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
在追求其他事物的过程中，你可能会失去对你而言珍贵的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Cultivating joy and happiness
is much like cultivating flowers.
If something is missing, the
flower will wilt away...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
培养喜悦与幸福
就像培育花朵一样。
如果缺少了什么，
花朵就会枯萎...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What brings you
to this kind of place?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是什么风把你
吹到这种地方来的？

scripts.text: I want to learn how to experiment.
scripts.translation: 我想学习融合试验。

scripts.text: Tell me more about flowers.
scripts.translation: 多告诉我一些关于花的事。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You wish to
learn Alchemy?
Everything I know,
I've learned for the
sake of making my
dream come true...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你想学习
融合试验？
我所知道的一切，
都是为了
实现我的梦想...
才去学习的...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I'll teach
you the basics...
But everything you
learn afterwards must
be directed through
your own motivations.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你
基础知识...
但之后你学到的一切，
都必须由
你自己的动机
来指引。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I will teach you
how to make simple
medicine. So please
bring the following
materials right away.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我会教你
制作简单的药剂。所以请
立刻准备
以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottles^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Once you have
prepared everything,
return to me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
准备好
所有东西后，
回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Flowers...?
In the darkest
recesses of my mind,
there is a blossum
that I faintly remember...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
花...？
在我脑海最黑暗的
角落深处，
有一朵我隐约记得的
花正在绽放...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
For the one that
I love, I put all
of my efforts into
researching that one thing.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
为了我所爱的人，我倾注了
所有的精力
去研究那一样东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I won't tell you the details,
but I was basically researching
the relationship between
wolves and flowers.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我不会告诉你细节，
但我基本上是在研究
狼和花之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
But yes...
It was a flower.
With its shine, it was said
to let you see paradise.
The ^551A8BIllusion Flower^000000...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
但是没错...
那是一朵花。
据说凭借它的光芒，
你可以看到天堂。
^551A8B幻想花^000000...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I even made
a Homunculus,
but no one believed that I could create new life from a flower...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我甚至创造了一个生命体，
但没人相信我能从一朵花中创造出新的生命...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Then...
Well, some other things happened, and now I have nothing left. Time no longer has any meaning for me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
然后...
后来发生了一些事，现在我已一无所有。时间对我来说已不再有意义。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Ahh...
Harmona...
Where have you gone?
I hope you're in a field
of beautiful flowers...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
哈莫娜...
你去了哪里？
我希望你在一片漂亮的花田里...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Consider what
is most precious
to you. It cannot
be protected if you
do not recognize it.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
想想对你来说最珍贵的是什么。
如果你不珍视它，就无法保护它。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...
......
Who is it...?

[Darwin]
Ah...
You are the one who
wishes to learn Alchemy.
Have you prepared everything?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
你就是那个想学习融合试验的人。
你准备好一切了吗？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wait.
That Illusion Flower.
How did you get that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等等。
那朵幻想花。
你是怎么得到的？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Where did you find it?!
The flower that slowly
blooms under the
moonlight?
It's beautiful...!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你在哪里找到的？！
那朵在月光下缓缓绽放的花？
真美...！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Th-That flower...
Please let me see it.
The Illusion Flower!
Uwaaaaaaah!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
那...那朵花...
请让我看看。
是幻想花！
哇啊啊啊啊！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Would you be so kind
as to let me have this flower?
I'm sure that this is the Moonlight Flower that I've been seeking!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你愿意把这朵花给我吗？
我确信这就是我苦苦寻找的月夜猫！

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't give it to you.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不能给你。

scripts.text: I brought it to give to you.
scripts.translation: 我特意带来送给你的。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
I understand.
You can't give
such a precious
flower to just anyone.
Well... It's okay.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我理解。
你不能把这么珍贵的花随便送给别人。
嗯...没关系。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
It just brought back old memories. I shouldn't have asked in the first place. In any case, please bring what is needed for the experiment.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
它只是勾起了我的旧回忆。我不该问的。总之，请带上实验所需的物品。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Please leave that flower
somewhere else. It brings
back too many memories...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
请把那朵花放在别处。它勾起了我太多的回忆...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Are you
serious?!
Thank you!
Such a precious flower.
Ah, Harmona, my love...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你是认真的？！
谢谢你！
这么珍贵的花。
啊，哈莫娜，我的爱人...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Yes...
I shall repay you for this.
I shall plant all of my knowledge of Alchemy directly into your mind...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
是的...
我会报答你的。
我会将我所有的融合试验知识直接植入你的脑海...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Open your eyes wide,
and look into my eyes!!
Don't stop until the end!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
睁大你的眼睛，
看着我的眼睛！！
直到最后都不要停下！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^666666*Gasp...*^000000
You are now
an Alchemist!!
Go to the Union
and cast away the last
vestiges of Merchant life!!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
^666666*倒吸一口凉气*^000000
你现在
是一名炼金术士了！！
去公会吧，
彻底摆脱商人的身份！！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Seems like you have everything ready. As promised, I will teach you how to make simple medicine.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
看来你已经准备好了。既然答应了，我就教你制作简单的药剂。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
First, prepare the Medicine Bowl. Then, you put the Herbs inside, like this, and slowly crush them.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
首先，准备好药钵。然后，像这样把草药放进去，慢慢研磨。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Pour small amounts
of clean water and stir
the mixture until it thickens.
Afterwards, add some more Herbs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
倒入少量的清水，搅拌混合物直到变稠。
之后，再加入一些草药。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
That's how you make it. If you think you have enough, gently pour the mixture into an empty bottle.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
就是这样制作的。如果你觉得量足够了，就轻轻地把混合物倒入空瓶中。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
There you go,
it's complete.
Now, make some medicine
using the simple procedure
I just explained to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
好了，
完成了。
现在，按照我刚才讲解的简单步骤，
制作一些药剂吧。

scripts.text: Prepare the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 准备药钵

scripts.text: Put the Medicine Bowl on your head.
scripts.translation: 把药钵顶在头上

scripts.text: Kick the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 踢药钵

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
What...?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
什...？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
No!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
不！

scripts.text: Put some dirt in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放些泥土

scripts.text: Put some Herbs in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放些草药

scripts.text: Put a Harp in the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 在药钵里放把竖琴

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
...Eh!?
That's not
medicine!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
...诶！？
这可不是
药剂！

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
A Harp?
And how would
you do that?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
竖琴？
而且你打算
怎么做？

scripts.text: Crush the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 捣碎草药

scripts.text: Crush the Medicine Bowl.
scripts.translation: 捣碎药钵

scripts.text: Crush Darwin's foot.
scripts.translation: 踩达尔文的脚

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Wh-What are
you doing!?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你...你在做什么！？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Agh...!
What do you
think you're
doing?!
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...！
你究竟想干什么？！

scripts.text: Spray clean water.
scripts.translation: 喷洒清水

scripts.text: Drink clean water.
scripts.translation: 喝清水

scripts.text: Pour clean water.
scripts.translation: 倒清水

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh?
What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
诶？
你在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
W-wait...
Are you
taking a break?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
等...等一下...
你是在休息吗？

scripts.text: Continue crushing the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续捣碎草药

scripts.text: Continue eating the Herbs.
scripts.translation: 继续吃草药

scripts.text: Continue dancing and singing.
scripts.translation: 继续唱歌跳舞

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Eat the Herbs?
I think you need
to focus on the
task at hand...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
吃草药？
我觉得你应该
专心做手头的工作...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Singing and
dancing? Alchemists
don't do that, have
you gone crazy?
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
唱歌跳舞？
炼金术士才不会那样做，
你疯了吗？

scripts.text: Put noodles in and fry it.
scripts.translation: 放入面条并煎炒

scripts.text: Pour it in an empty bottle.
scripts.translation: 倒入空瓶中

scripts.text: Hold the Medicine Bowl and drink it.
scripts.translation: 拿着药钵喝

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
We're Alchemists,
not restaurant chefs.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
我们是炼金术士，
不是餐厅的厨师。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Huh...
Pretty sloppy...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
诶...
真够邋遢的...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
You messed up the mixture
since you didn't follow the procedure! Get some more ingredients so you can try it
again until you get it right.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你没有按照步骤操作，所以把混合物搞砸了！
去多拿些材料，再试一次，直到做对为止。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Good job.
It came out pretty well considering it's your first time. Go ahead and keep the medicines that you've just made.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
干得好。
考虑到你是第一次尝试，结果还算不错。
把你刚才做的药保留下来吧。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Now, go into the next room
and speak to Van Helmont to
continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
现在，去隔壁房间
和范·赫尔蒙特对话，
继续你的训练。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Never forget...
You must always protect
what is most precious to you.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
永远不要忘记...
你必须时刻保护
对你来说最珍贵的东西。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Have you forgotten
what you need to bring?
Let me remind you once
again. You must come
back with...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
你忘了需要带什么了吗？
让我再提醒你一次。
你必须带回...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
^551A8B3 Medicine Bowls^000000,
^551A8B3 Empty Bottle^000000,
^551A8B1 Red Herb^000000,
^551A8B1 Yellow Herb^000000 and
^551A8B1 White Herb^000000.

[Darwin]
Come back
when you are
ready...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
准备好了
再回来...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Aah...
Harmona, my love.
I can't even see the flower anymore. My soul quietly
withers as well..
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
啊...
哈罗娜，我的爱人。
我甚至已经看不见那朵花了。我的灵魂也在静静地枯萎...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Go to the second floor and talk to speak to our Union Leader. Once
you do that, your life as an Alchemist will begin.
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
去二楼和我们的公会首领对话。
做完这些，你作为炼金术士的生活就开始了。

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
These cursed eyes...
They've lost sight of
my dreams a long time ago.
Ha ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
这该死的双眼...
早已看不见
我的梦想了。
哈哈哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Darwin]
Does paradise
really exist...?
Not without my love...
Not without Harmona...
scripts.translation:
[达尔文]
天堂
真的存在吗...？
没有我的爱人...
没有哈莫娜...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What do you want?
I'm busy!! Don't
bother me and get
on your way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你想干什么？
我很忙！！别打扰我，
快走吧。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Just a little...
A little bit more...
Nooo! Just a little
bit more and it
would've been done!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
就差一点...
再一点点...
不！再一点点就
能完成了！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Arrrrgh...!
Why isn't this formula working? What's wrong? In theory, it's all correct, but there must be an error in the formula somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊...
为什么这个配方不起作用？哪里出错了？理论上都是正确的，但配方里肯定有某个地方出错了...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Alright, if I make an incision here in the Tentacle, and add a Jellopy and Sticky Mucus solution into the... Where the hell did my Medicine Bowl go?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好吧，如果在这里切开触手，加入杰勒比结晶和粘稠液体溶液到...我的药钵去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What...?
I thought I told you to
talk to Nicholas next door?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
什么...？
我让你去和隔壁的尼古拉斯对话了吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Now, come on...
You'll never get
any research completed if you just slack off. Go out and learn all that you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好了，快去吧...
如果你只是偷懒，永远也完成不了研究。出去多学点东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Reading science journals and performing experiments. That's what Alchemy is all about. Now, let me get back to work!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
阅读科学期刊并进行实验。这就是融合试验的全部。好了，让我回去工作！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! W-Wait...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么...？！
为什么又失败了？！
我的计算都是正确的！等...等等...！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许，如果我利用中子梯度来容纳热流，说不定就能成功...！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I pour it in here, and it should stop. Wait, this is the wrong solution! How could I make such
a dumb mistake?! When did these
get switched?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
倒在这里，应该就会停止。等等，这是错的溶液！我怎么会犯这种愚蠢的错误？！什么时候被换掉的？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, okay...
I just need to fix this part.
No need to start over. I just
need to fix it... But wait. Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好的，好的...
我只需要修复这部分。
不需要从头再来。我只
需要修复它...但是等等。等等...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Um...
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...
你是谁？

scripts.text: I want to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...？
怎么，你只是想看看？好吧，好吧，但请安静点，看完就立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡我的路，也别乱碰东西。这里有些挥发性材料，发生事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You...?
An Alchemist?
What a funny Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你...？
炼金术士？
真是个奇怪的商人。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well, that's nice, but I have very urgent experiments that require
my attention, so don't get
in the way.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯，这很好，但我有非常紧急的实验需要处理，所以别妨碍我。

scripts.text: Teach me something.
scripts.translation: 教我一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Argh...!
Didn't I just tell you not to bother me? What's so hard to understand about that?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊...！
我不是刚说过别打扰我吗？这有什么难懂的吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Fine, fine. I'll give you an assignment. Learn something
new and come back. Let's see.
What would be good...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好吧，好吧。我给你布置个任务。去学点新东西，然后回来。让我想想。
什么好呢...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Okay, I got it.
Go learn how to make
a Counteragent and Mixture
from Molgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
好了，我想到了。
去莫尔根斯坦那里学一下
如何制作中和剂和混合剂。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
You don't need to bring anything. Just go watch him at work and have him tell you how he makes those solutions. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你不需要带任何东西。只要去看着他工作，让他告诉你他是如何配制那些溶液的。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Well then, see you later.
You'd better get going as
soon as you can.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
那么，回头见。
你最好尽快出发。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
...
......

[Van Helmont]
So if I recalibrate the combustion rate of this compound, that should negate any cohesive tendencies in this particle flux...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
如果我重新校准这种化合物的燃烧率，应该就能抵消粒子流中的任何凝聚倾向...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
But what am I going to do
about all of this spontaneous
crystallization?! I can't very well remove this matrix, I need it for the catalyst to reach the triple point.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
但我该怎么处理这些自发的结晶现象呢？！我不能移除这个基质，我需要它让催化剂达到三相点。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Damn!
What am
I going to do?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
该死！
我该怎么办？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Did I use them all at a time like this?! I wonder if Nicholas has any left. Ugh, what a pain. Wait. Wait a minute...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我居然在这种时候把它们都用完了！不知道尼古拉斯那里还有没有。唉，真麻烦。等等。等一下...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
...
......
Who are you?
I want to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation: 我想成为炼金术士？

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Hmm...?
What, did you just want to watch? Fine, fine, but do it quietly and leave right when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
嗯...？
怎么，你只是想看看？好吧，好吧，但请安静点，看完就立刻离开。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Stay out of my way and don't go around touching stuff. There might be some volatile materials, so it'd be dangerous to have any accidents.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
别挡我的路，也别乱碰东西。这里有些挥发性材料，发生事故会很危险。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Ah, of course. The Merchant from before. So what did you learn from Molgenstein? I didn't just send you there for fun, you know.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
啊，原来是你。之前的商人。
那么，你在莫尔根斯坦那里学到了什么？
我可没让你去那里玩，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Let me ask you
some questions to
check what you've
learned.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
让我问你几个问题，
检查一下你学到了什么。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Which item is not
necessary to make
a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作中和剂时，
哪个物品是不需要的？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item is not
necessary to make
a Mixture?
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
制作混合剂时，
哪个物品是不需要的？

scripts.text: Karvodailnirol
scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪药水

scripts.text: Detrimindexta
scripts.translation: 帝特立米药水

scripts.text: Alcohol
scripts.translation: 酒精

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Weren't you listening to Molgenstein at all? Maybe you
have to watch him make it again.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你根本没听莫尔根斯坦讲吗？
也许你得再看着他做一遍。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
If you can't tell the exact items that you need in an experiment,
you might end up hurting yourself!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
如果你不知道实验需要哪些具体物品，
可能会伤到自己！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Good, you've learned well.
Okay, now you know something about experimentation. You're done here, so now I can continue with my experiments.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
很好，你学得不错。
好了，现在你对实验有了一些了解。
你在这里的任务结束了，所以我可以继续我的实验了。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Go out and find the room next
to this one and talk to Nicholas. He'll continue your training.
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
出去找到隔壁的房间，
和尼古拉斯谈谈。他会继续指导你。

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What are you
still doing here?
Go! We both have
more important
things to do!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
你还在这里干什么？
快走！我们都有
更重要的事要做！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
What item do

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Be honest. You don't know, do you?! Didn't I say to go to Molgenstein and have him teach you?!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
老实说，你不知道吧？！我不是让你去莫尔根斯坦找莫尔根斯坦教你吗？！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Don't even think about coming back until you talk to him! Now stop bothering me and get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
没跟他谈完之前，别想回来！现在别烦我了，给我出去！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
I need to continue my research,
and you need to finish becoming an Alchemist. Come on, get moving!
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
我得继续我的研究，你也得赶紧完成炼金术士的修行。快点，动起来！

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Why...?!
Why, another failure?!
My calculations were
all correct! Wait...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
为什么...？！
为什么又失败了？！
我的计算明明都是正确的！等等...

scripts.text:
[Van Helmont]
Perhaps, if I capacitated the thermal flux by using the neutronic gradient, it just might work...
scripts.translation:
[范·赫尔蒙特]
也许，如果我利用中子梯度来容纳热流，说不定就能成功...

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You have transcended...
Excellent, excellent.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你已经超越了...
很好，非常好。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Welcome!
So how is your
research coming along?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
欢迎！
你的研究进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hm...
A Novice?
You shouldn't be
playing in a place
like this.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...
一个初心者？
你不应该
在这种地方
玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
What's an adventurer
doing here in the
Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...？
一个冒险者
为什么会出现在
炼金术士工会？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...?
A Merchant?
Are you interested
in learning Alchemy?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...？
一个商人？
你对学习
炼金术感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Hmm...you don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
嗯...你似乎还不符合资格。
请记住，你必须达到职业等级40才能成为炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, you're almost
ready to become an
Alchemist, but you must
first allocate your unused
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，你几乎准备好
成为炼金术士了，
但你必须
先分配你未使用的
技能点。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah, well done.
I can see that you
have learned all of
the basics of Alchemy.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊，做得好。
我看得出你
已经学会了
炼金术的所有基础。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Ah...
I believe you've
already registered
for training to become
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
啊...
我想你
已经注册
参加炼金术士
的修行了。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
You don't belong here.
Go and explore the wide world, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
你不属于这里。
去探索广阔的世界吧，我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
At times you get results that are unexpected from an experiment. Although these may be setbacks in your research, such results can also lead to new discoveries.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
有时候实验会得到意想不到的结果。虽然这些可能是研究中的挫折，但这样的结果也可能带来新的发现。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
If you discover something new,
come and tell us. Don't forget that we are all working together to unlock the mysteries of science!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
如果你发现了什么新东西，
来告诉我们。别忘了，我们都在共同努力，解开科学的奥秘！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
There are a lot of volatile chemicals and dangerous
materials in this building. It'd be a lot better if you just played outside.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这栋楼里有很多挥发性化学品和危险材料。你最好还是去外面玩。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'm afraid there's
not much we can offer
you here if you're not
a member of our Union.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
恐怕如果你不是我们工会的成员，
我们在这里能提供的服务
就不多了。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
This is the Alchemist Union.
We research and experiment with many different substances in order to create new materials without using magic.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
这里是炼金术士工会。
我们研究和实验各种不同物质，以便在不使用魔法的情况下创造新材料。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Someday, we hope to unlock
the secret of life, as well as the other mysteries of science.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
总有一天，我们希望解开生命的秘密，以及科学的其他奥秘。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
After being traveling as a Merchant for a long time, you must have developed some scientific curiosity. If you'd like to learn Alchemy, why don't you try joining the Alchemist Union?
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
作为一名商人，你长途跋涉了这么久，一定也产生了一些科学上的好奇心。如果你想学习炼金术，为什么不加入炼金术士工会呢？

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Talk to me again
once you have spent
all of your extra
Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
等你把多余的
技能点都用完之后，
再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Henceforth, you are
now a member of our
illustrious Union.
I hope you learn a lot...
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
从今以后，
你就是我们
显赫工会的一员了。
希望你能学到很多东西...

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Let me give you
something special.
You can use this to
begin your life
of research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
让我给你
一些特别的东西。
你可以用它
开始你的
研究生活。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
And...
Here's a little
something to help
you begin your
research.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
还有...
这里有一点小东西，
帮助你
开始你的
研究。

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
I'll see
you later then...
Remember to carry
yourself with pride
as an Alchemist!
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
那我先走了...
记得要
以炼金术士的
身份自豪地生活！

scripts.text:
[Vincent Carsciallo]
Please listen to the
other Alchemists and follow their instructions carefully. You will learn much from them.
scripts.translation:
[文森特·卡西阿洛]
请听从其他炼金术士的指示，并仔细遵循他们的指导。你会从他们那里学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back again -
- after you store some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -

- 太多了。 -

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ooh...
You're the upstart
Merchant that wants
to become an Alchemist?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
噢...
你就是那个想要
成为炼金术士的
新晋商人？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Not just anyone can become an Alchemist, you know. You've got to have motivation and clear goals and a strong sense of focus.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
不是谁都能成为炼金术士的，你知道吗。你必须要有动力、明确的目标和强烈的专注力。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alchemists must memorize many chemical equations, scientific laws and a lot of other information. It's actually pretty tough.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
炼金术士必须记住许多化学方程式、科学定律以及大量的其他信息。这其实相当困难。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't focus, you'll be confused later when you look at Alchemy charts. My test will judge your ability to do just that.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你无法集中注意力，之后看炼金术图表时就会感到困惑。我的测试将判断你是否有这种能力。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Find the words scrambled
in the group of letters I give you. They can be made by using some
or all of the letters.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
在我给你的字母组中，
找出被打乱顺序的单词。
它们可以由部分
或全部字母组成。

scripts.translation:

^551A8BIN^000000谜题中的单词，
你就通过了。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
Excellent job!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你完成了。
那么，让我们看看...
干得漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you finished.
Now, let's see...
^666666*Gasp!*^000000 H-horrible!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你完成了。
那么，让我们看看...
^666666*倒吸一口凉气！*^000000 糟...糟透了！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Great, you found all of those hidden words. With that kind of concentration, you should have no problem memorizing information.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
很好，你找到了所有那些隐藏的字。以这种专注力，你应该能毫无问题地记住信息。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back in a little bit while
I prepare the next assignment
for your training.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
等我准备好下一个训练任务，你再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Oh, and before you talk to
me again, make sure you have
^551A8Bplenty of room in your inventory^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哦，对了，在我再次和你对话之前，请确保你的^551A8B物品栏有足够的空间^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Judging from these results, you obviously have a problem with concentrating.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
从这些结果来看，你显然在专注力方面有问题。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you can't even solve these easy word puzzles, how can you keep track of your experiments and research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你连这些简单的文字谜题都解不开，怎么能跟上你的实验和研究进度呢？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Why don't you relax
and rest a bit before
you take the test again?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
你为什么不先放松休息一下，然后再重新参加测试呢？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Whoa...
You're carrying too much stuff! First, put some of your things in Kafra Storage.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
哇...
你带了太多东西！首先，把一些东西放进卡普拉仓库吧。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright...
For your next
assignment, you'll
need to travel to ^551A8BJuno^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好吧...
对于你的下一个任务，
你需要前往^551A8B朱诺^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
There, you'll need to talk to ^551A8BBain^000000 and ^551A8BBajin^000000. Those two are doing Alchemy research with the Sages
in Juno. You'll learn something by assisting them with their project.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
在那里，你需要与^551A8B贝恩^000000和^551A8B巴金^000000交谈。那两位正在朱诺与贤者们一起进行融合试验研究。通过协助他们的计划，你会学到一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Come back here to me after you
help them out. They'll need all of these items to continue their experiments.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
帮完他们之后，回到我这里来。他们需要所有这些物品来继续他们的实验。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
1 Mixture,
5 Burnt Tree,
5 Fine Sand,
3 Rough Oridecon
and 3 Rough Elunium.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
1个混合剂，
5个燃烧一半的木材，
5个黄晶沙，
3个神之金属原石
和3个铝原石。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Alright.
Have a safe trip
and come back in
one piece.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
好的。
祝你旅途平安，
并平安归来。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Didn't I say to
go to Juno and help
Bain and Bajin with
their Alchemy research?
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
我难道不是让你去朱诺，
帮助贝恩和巴金
进行融合试验研究吗？

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Ah, you're back!
I just got a message from Bain
and Bajin. They let me know that they were very happy with your assistance.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
啊，你回来了！
我刚收到贝恩和巴金的消息。他们告诉我，他们对你的帮助非常满意。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
If you were good enough
to help out those brothers,
you definitely qualify to be
an Alchemist.
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
如果你能帮到那兄弟俩，
那你绝对有资格成为一名炼金术士。

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
Good work!
All you have to do now is speak to the Union Leader on the 2nd floor! Congratulations, you'll become an Alchemist very soon!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
干得好！
现在你只需要去二楼与工会首领对话！恭喜你，你很快就能成为炼金术士了！

scripts.text:
[Nicholas Flamel]
All you have to do now is speak to the Union Leader on the 2nd floor! Congratulations, you'll become an Alchemist very soon!
scripts.translation:
[尼古拉·弗拉梅尔]
现在你只需要去二楼与工会首领对话！恭喜你，你很快就能成为炼金术士了！
